title: Browse static object layouts
changes: Expose extracted static OBJ lists in the scoped object viewer, retaining source offsets and object attributes and reusing manual graphics and palette selection.
Label layouts as static, disable their playback controls and preserve ordinary animation controls when changing catalogs.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-static-obj-synthetic-trxww2fv passed 44 projection, browser and regression checks.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-static-obj-recovered-fxvkosah matched all 289 source ranges and the full catalog JSON hash; Chrome checked 274 lists, 1229 objects and six empty layouts.
The same unit matched all 12 Docker/Python output files; two validated ignored wiki pages were published with guarded preimages.
limitations: Graphics and palettes are paired manually; live object effects and the original compositing context are not reconstructed. The other catalog metadata remains inspectable through the file inspector; other previews/audio and native Windows remain open.
